rules.statement: When a purchaser at a Fiscal's sale conveys before he has himself obtained a Fiscal's transfer and then subsequently obtains a transfer, the benefit of the transfer enures to the purchaser.
rules.supporting_quote: "This was clearly understood to be the law before the passing of the present Code, as shown by the following authorities: Selohamy v. Raphiel 3 and Silva v. Tissera. 4"
